aliases: Gao

entries.en: Bring your axe, Gaolequ. Let's head into the forest.
entries.zh: 把斧子带上，高勒趣。跟我进林子。
aliases: Come on, Gaolequ. Let's hunt, and bring back some wood.
走吧，高勒趣。进林子打猎，再带些木头回来。

entries.en: How far are we going today?
aliases: I'm ready, Father.
我准备好了，父亲。

entries.en: Not far. We'll be home before dark.
aliases: Stay close. We won't go far.
跟紧我，我们不会走太远。

entries.en: It's across the river... Are we still going after it?
aliases: Did you see the size of that boar?
看见那头野猪没有？这么大一头！

entries.en: We can't let one that big get away.
entries.zh: 这么大一头，不能就这么放跑了。
aliases: It's gone across the river. Come on!
它往河对岸去了。咱们跟上！

entries.en: That's enough for today. Let's go home.
aliases: That's enough. Let's go home.
够了，回家吧。

entries.en: My knife... I left it across the river.
aliases: My knife... I must have left it back there.
我的刀……怕是落在刚才那边了。

entries.en: No, wait here. I'll get it and come straight back.
entries.zh: 不用，你在这儿等着。拿了刀我就回来。
aliases: Wait here. I'll be right back.
你在这儿等我，很快就回来。

entries.en: So it was you who killed my wild boar!
entries.zh: 原来是你杀了我的野猪！

entries.en: Three days and three nights pass.
He said he'd come straight back...
aliases: He said he'd be right back...
他说很快就回来的……

entries.en: I can't keep waiting. I have to find him.
entries.zh: 我不能再等了。我得去找他。
aliases: I have to find him.
我得去找他。

entries.en: His father never made it home alive. Gaolequ returned to the forest alone.
entries.zh: 父亲终究没能活着回来。高勒趣独自回到了这片树林。

entries.en: Back then, I thought the forest would never run out.
entries.zh: 那时候，总觉得林子里的东西取不完。
aliases: These trees... we cut them down.
这些树……都是我们砍的。

entries.en: I'll start by bringing the trees back.
entries.zh: 先让这里再长出树来吧。
aliases: I'll plant trees here again.
先把树种回来吧。

entries.en:
Hunt with Father
Explore the western woods.
entries.zh:
与父亲一同狩猎
探索西侧树林。

entries.en: A great boar crosses the river.
entries.zh: 一头大野猪奔向河对岸。

entries.en:
Return to Father
He wants to speak about the boar.
entries.zh:
回到父亲身边
他想和你说说那头野猪。

entries.en:
Hunt the great boar
Cross the river to the eastern clearing.
entries.zh:
猎捕大野猪
过河前往东侧空地。

entries.en:
Head home together
Cross back to the western bank.
entries.zh:
一起回家
过河返回西岸。

entries.en:
Wait for Father
He has gone back for his knife.
entries.zh:
等父亲回来
他回去找刀了。

entries.en:
Find Father
Follow the woods eastward.
entries.zh:
寻找父亲
沿树林向东走。

entries.en:
The rescue journey
Continue east within the scroll.
entries.zh:
救父之旅
沿卷轴继续向东。

entries.en:
The forest is renewed
You can keep caring for it.
entries.zh:
森林重获生机
你仍可以继续照料它。

entries.en:
Restore the clearing
E  Replant the stumps.
entries.zh:
恢复这片树林
E  在树桩处补种。

entries.en:
Let the forest recover
Replant and tend the trees.
entries.zh:
让森林慢慢恢复
补种并照料树木。

entries.en:
Life is returning
Care for plants and animals.
entries.zh:
生机正在回来
照料植物与动物。
树已砍倒 · E 补种

entries.en: The world has returned to its beginning
Move closer to a plant or animal
Grown up - next feeding brings a youngster
entries.zh: 已经长大，再次喂养可繁殖幼兽

entries.en: The clearing is full of animals
entries.zh: 这片空地的动物已经够多了

entries.en: Fed - a new animal joins nearby
entries.zh: 喂养成功，幼兽在旁边出生了

entries.en: This spot is crowded - feed in an open area
entries.zh: 这里太挤了，请到开阔处喂养
这棵树已照料过，请选择其他树
周围的新植物还在生长

entries.en: New plants are growing around this tree
entries.zh: 新植物正在这棵树周围生长

entries.en: This patch is full - tend another tree
entries.zh: 这里已经长满了，请照料其他树

entries.en: Story Mode enabled — Father is following
entries.zh: 已进入故事模式，父亲与你同行

entries.en: This is “stone”. It is blocking the <color=#FFDC88>spring on the high ground</color>.
entries.zh: 这就是“石”。它堵住了<color=#FFDC88>高处的泉眼</color>。

entries.en: Gaolequ, place “white stone” on the high ground to form the <color=#FFDC88>spirit seat</color>.
entries.zh: 高勒趣，把“白石”砌在高处，组成<color=#FFDC88>神位</color>。

entries.en: High ground is “white”; low ground is “black”.
I need to turn “stone” into “white stone” before I can place it on the spirit seat.
entries.zh: 需要把“石”变成“白石”，才能够放到神位上。

entries.en: This is not enough “white stone” to build the spirit seat.
entries.zh: 如果需要构建神位，这点“白石”可不行。

entries.en: I should look elsewhere for more materials.
entries.zh: 去别的地方再找找材料吧。

entries.en: These do not seem to form a meaningful combination.
entries.zh: 似乎无法组成合理的含义。

entries.en: The spirit seat is ready. Now…
My father, you had been caught by the God <color=#FFDC88>Shu</color>.
My father, how can I find your trace?
entries.zh: 父亲，我该去哪里寻找你的踪迹？

entries.en: Exactly. Dear fox, how do you know us?
entries.zh: 是的。狐狸，你怎么会认识我们？

entries.en: Gao, the damage you two have caused to nature was so much!
entries.zh: 高勒趣，你们父子给自然造成了太多伤害！

entries.en: You even violated the contract and captured the wild boar of the God Shu!
entries.zh: 你们甚至违背约定，猎杀了署神的野猪！

entries.en: Well...but I don't think Shu has the right to catch my father.
entries.zh: 可是……我不觉得署有权抓走我的父亲。

entries.en: Gao, your father is imprisoned on <color=#9876C5>the fifth hill</color>, and <color=#FFDC88>this</color> is the first one.
entries.zh: 高勒趣，你父亲被关在<color=#9876C5>第五座山</color>上，而<color=#FFDC88>这里</color>才是第一座。

entries.en: To <color=#6AADFF>reconcile</color> rather than continue to destroy nature, otherwise you will also fall into the same fate.
entries.zh: 去<color=#6AADFF>和解</color>，别再破坏自然，否则你也会落得同样的下场。

entries.en: My father often said that, the south slope is sunny, the north valley is shady.
entries.zh: 父亲常说，南坡向阳，北谷背阴。

entries.en: And all white things go up, all black things go down, that's the rule.
entries.zh: 白的归于高处，黑的归于低处，这是规矩。

entries.en: The snakes are twisting with each other, I can't pass through this way…
entries.zh: 两条蛇缠在一起，挡住了去路……

entries.en: Well…the stones seem to be the next trouble.
entries.zh: 看来……接下来要想办法搬开这些石头了。

entries.en: If I go to resolve the dispute between these two snakes first, will I also find another way?
entries.zh: 如果先解开这两条蛇之间的纠缠，是不是就能找到另一条路？

entries.en: So many rocks, I'm definitely reaching the peak.
entries.zh: 石头越来越多，应该快到山顶了。
我会好好照料这片树林。

entries.en: Return to the opening by the hearth. All progress in this run will be lost.
entries.zh: 将回到火塘旁的开场，本次游玩进度不会保留。

entries.en: There is no saved progress. Leaving will end this run.
entries.zh: 当前没有存档，离开后本次游玩进度不会保留。

entries.en: You can stay in the forest and keep exploring.
entries.zh: 你可以留在森林里，继续探索与照料。

entries.en: Controls all game audio. Settings are saved on this computer.
entries.zh: 调节所有游戏声音。设置会保存在这台电脑上。
已喂养，幼兽出现在附近

entries.en: Approach a stump, then press E to replant.
entries.zh: 靠近树桩，按 E 补种。
E   补种 / 照料 / 喂养
H   打开 / 关闭操作说明
R   重新开始整个故事
